newsitem.title: USA: Stockpile cobalt court case decision due May 20.
newsitem.headline: Stockpile cobalt court case decision due May 20.

text.p: The result of a court case involving U.S. Stockpile and Minor Metals Inc regarding government sales of surplus cobalt, will be issued in writing on May 20, an attorney for the Stockpile said.

Minor Metals complained to the U.S. Court of Federal Claims that Stockpile acted contrary to the law by prohibiting "all or none bids" in the way it sold cobalt. Two other, related issues are part of the Federal Claims case.
Judge Tidwell said he would issue his decision in writing following oral hearings that were held Thursday.
Stockpile's cobalt sales have been suspended since March.
Another Minor Metals complaint regarding the February sale of cobalt was thrown out by the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia.
